verdict.rationale: PayPal's own REST docs invite developers to 'import OpenAPI documents into compatible third-party tools'. Its official paypal-rest-api-specifications repo hosts OpenAPI JSON files such as openapi/checkout_orders_v2.json, used directly for codegen. Together these show a downloadable, machine-readable spec. Missing for 10: an explicit inventory showing which PayPal APIs have published specs, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the specs are complete and current.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: Explore our REST API descriptions, generate code for your API clients, and import OpenAPI documents into compatible third-party tools.
